title: flywheel: flywheel_synthesize_rubric input
description: Synthesize / validate / edit / regenerate the cycle-level outcome rubric at .pi-flywheel/plans/<slug>/rubric.md. Called from skills/start/_planning.md Step 5.6 after the plan-ready gate fires. Discriminator on success: kind ∈ { rubric_synthesized, rubric_preserved (cache hit on edited/user source), rubric_edited (action=edit), rubric_validated (action=validate) }. Errors surface FlywheelErrorCode envelopes (rubric_synth_invalid, rubric_missing, invalid_input).

planSlug.description: Plan slug. Optional; falls back to slugifying state.outcomeRubricPath / planPath / state.planDocument.

planPath.description: Path to the plan markdown (relative to cwd or absolute). Required for synthesize/regenerate when state.planDocument is unset.

action.description: synthesize=spawn synthesizer (cache + edited-source guard); validate=parse current rubric.md; edit=apply editIntent; regenerate=force=true synth (overrides edited-source guard).

editIntent.description: Required when action=edit. Tighten/add/remove are deterministic transforms; custom routes through the LLM.

text.description: Free-form instruction or single criterion text.

force.description: Bypass the planContentSha cache and the edited-source guard. Equivalent to action=regenerate.
